name: SP-FUEL-LVL - fuel sender signal + 470R pull-up to ECU-B B24
SP-SHIELD-B - loom B cable drains to ECU-B B17
SP-5V-B - +5V from loom A to fuel level, evap, rear WS
SP-GNDOUT-B - ECU-B B22 sensor ground to fuel, A/C, evap, rear WS, bulkhead B
SP-GND-BHB - sensor ground to bulkhead B (knock, B-engine sensors)
SP-REV - reverse switch out to CSB3 opto + reverse relay
SP-AC-BTN - A/C switch divider mid-point to ECU-B B31
SP-EVAP - evap thermistor + 2.2k pull-up to ECU-B B32
At the rear WS inline - SP-SHIELD-B-WSR: rear wheel-speed drains
location: At the rear WS inline (layout node bp_1020)
